location: ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md Consistency 'Tests' (`backend/app/features/<slice>/tests/`, `backend/app/shared/tests/`); AD-4 'a test posts one valid request per action member through the real app'; Story 2.10 'every endpoint a later story adds'
trigger_condition: Tests that build the real app import `app.main`, which imports registry and every slice. Placed inside `app.shared` or `app.features.<slice>`, they create indirect imports shared -> features and slice -> slice. import-linter's independence and forbidden contracts check indirect chains, so legitimate tests fail CI. If the test folders skip `__init__.py` to dodge this, pytest's default import mode fails on duplicate basenames (e.g. `test_api.py` in ten slices).

potential_consequence: The first DB-backed test in Story 1.3 or 2.2 turns CI red against the contracts, and the team silences them with broad ignores, so the boundary check stops meaning anything.

location: ARCHITECTURE-SPINE.md AD-21 Imports (frontend) and Lint convention; epics.md Story 1.2 CI criterion; Structural Seed `frontend/src/test/fixtures/`
trigger_condition: `import/no-restricted-paths` cannot say 'features/X not features/Y' generically. It needs one zone per slice with `except`, kept in sync with ten names. It only fires on imports its resolver can resolve, so `@/` aliases need the TypeScript resolver. It cannot ban `fetch`, a global call the spine attributes to the same zones. Vitest tests in `features/*` importing `src/test/fixtures/` would also be refused. Story 1.2 has no frontend example slice and no expected-failure test.
guard_snippet: Generate the zones from the slice list in `eslint.config.mjs`: for each slice, `target: ./src/features/<s>`, `from: ./src/features`, `except: ['./<s>']`, plus `shared` -> {features, app} denied. Set `import/resolver: { typescript: true }`. Ban `fetch` with `no-restricted-globals` and `no-restricted-properties` outside `src/shared/api/`. Move fixtures to `src/shared/test/fixtures/`. Add a lint fixture expected to error.
potential_consequence: Aliased cross-feature imports pass lint silently, or the fixtures zone blocks every component test. The frontend half of AD-21 then gives a false sense of isolation.
